title: Im Hasengrund, Rüsselsheim
description:
This modern apartment combines comfort, convenience and an excellent location in Rüsselsheim am Main. It is an ideal choice for professionals, business travellers, students, expats and anyone looking for a comfortable, move-in-ready home in the Rhine-Main region.

The apartment is conveniently located near Frankfurt Airport and offers excellent connections to Frankfurt, Mainz, Wiesbaden and the surrounding area. Supermarkets, public transport and everyday amenities are all within easy reach.

Rental Conditions
Monthly rent: €900 – all-inclusive
Long-term stays of 6 months or more: €855 per month
Included: utilities, heating, water and kitchen
Security deposit: required; amount depends on the rental duration

Ideal for
Business professionals and commuters
Employees working near Frankfurt Airport
International professionals and expats
Students and interns
Temporary or long-term stays
Relocation to the Rhine-Main region

Location – Rüsselsheim am Main

Conveniently located at Hasengrund in Rüsselsheim am Main, this apartment is situated in a quiet and established residential area with excellent access to shopping facilities, public transport and the wider Rhine-Main region.

Shops & Supermarkets

Several supermarkets and everyday shopping facilities are located within easy reach:

REWE – approx. 0.4 km
Lidl – approx. 0.6 km
ALDI SÜD – approx. 0.8 km
Kaufland – approx. 1.5 km
GLOBUS – approx. 3.5 km

The nearby shopping options make everyday grocery shopping particularly convenient. A pharmacy is also located approximately 0.4 km away.

Public Transport – ÖPNV

The apartment has excellent local public transport connections. A bus stop is located only about 0.2 km away, making it easy to reach the city centre and Rüsselsheim railway station.

Rüsselsheim Central Station (Bahnhof) is approximately 1.6 km away. From there, passengers have access to regional train connections throughout the Rhine-Main area.

Connectivity

Rüsselsheim is strategically located in the Rhine-Main metropolitan region:

Frankfurt Airport: approx. 15 km
Frankfurt city centre: approx. 25–30 km
Mainz: approx. 15 km
Wiesbaden: approx. 25 km

The nearby motorway network provides convenient access to the A60, A67 and A3, making the apartment particularly suitable for commuters.

Leisure & Recreation

The Hasengrund area offers a pleasant residential environment with opportunities for walking, cycling and outdoor activities. Restaurants, cafés, fitness facilities and further everyday amenities are available throughout Rüsselsheim.

This all-inclusive apartment combines comfortable living, excellent shopping options and convenient public transport connections in the Rhine-Main region.

With supermarkets such as REWE, Lidl and ALDI SÜD within approximately 1 km, a nearby bus stop and Rüsselsheim railway station only around 1.6 km away, the location is particularly convenient for both short- and long-term stays.

Whether you are working in Rüsselsheim, Frankfurt, Mainz, Wiesbaden or at Frankfurt Airport, this apartment provides a practical and well-connected base in the Rhine-Main area.

title: Eifelstraße, Rüsselsheim
description:
O B J E K T

Voll möblierte 3-Zimmer-Wohnung im 1.OG eines Wohnhauses mit nur 3 Parteien.

Die Wohnung besteht aus 
- offenem Wohn-/Esszimmer mit Zugang zu Küche und Balkon
- 2 separaten Schlafzimmern (eines mit Zugang zum Balkon)
- einer offenen Küche mit Essplatz
- einer Diele mit Garderobe
- Balkon

A U S S T A T T U N G 

- Zentralheizung mit Fußbodenheizung
- Echtholzparkett (Eiche)
- Wannenbad 
- bodentiefe Wärme- und Schallschutzfenster (3-fach-vergast)
- elektrische Rollläden 
- Wände mit Glattputz (ohne Tapeten)
- Satelliten-TV

Darüber hinaus ist die Wohnung vollständig (inkl. Geschirr, Besteck & Waschmaschine) möbliert - siehe Bilder!

L A G E

Das Haus steht in einer kleinen Nebenstraße im sauberen und gepflegten Rüsselsheimer Vorort Königstädten.

Von Hier aus sind es nur wenige Minuten mit dem Auto über die A60/A3 (Mönchhofdreieick) zum Frankfurter Flughafen.

In der Nähe liegen Geschäfte des täglichen Bedarfs: Supermarkt, Bäcker, Apotheke, Post, Restaurants.

Das Haus liegt nur wenige Meter vom Waldrand und einem kleinen See entfernt - ideale Voraussetzungen zum Sport oder zur Erholung.
